Name: Alternative Leah Portraits - Seasonal
Author: TrashRacc1124
Description:
[size=2]This mod changes Leah's Portrait and Sprite to appear slightly cuter with longer and flowing hair. This mod is compatible with [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister's[/url] [/size][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450?tab=description]"Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic"[/url][size=2] Mod.

[/size][size=3][b]HOW TO INSTALL[/b]
[/size]
1) Download the "(CP) Alternate Leah Portraits - Vanilla" file [b]OR[/b] "Alternative Leah Portraits - Seasonal Cute Outfits" file
2) Extract the file
3) Drop the mod into your "mods" file

[b]REQUIREMENTS
[/b][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
(Optional) [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450?tab=description]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url]

[b]CREDITS
[/b][size=3]Thank you so much to [/size][size=3][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/70148453]AirynS[/url] for creating the code template for the Seasonal cute characters. For mod authors, you can download the template mod [/size][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14983][size=3]here
[/size][/url]
[size=3]The assets from [b]"Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic"[/b] by [b]"Poltergeister"[/b] where made by various authors and are credited below.[/size]

Spring & Fall: [b]IronZelly
[/b]Summer: [b]Poltergeister
[/b]Winter Inside: [b]Jaksha / Poltergeister[/b] (adapted from Abigail from Longevity)
Winter Outside: [b]Jaksha[/b] (adapted from Abigail from Longevity)
Festival Outfits: [b]Poltergeister
[/b]Beach: [b]Poltergeister
[/b]Sprites: [b]Poltergeister
[/b]
